---
title: "Dual language immersion and the PPS rightsizing scenarios"
subtitle: "What Scenarios A and B (released October 2026) would change for immersion families"
toc: false
---

```{r}
source("R/site_data.R")

sp_k5 <- sites |> filter(language == "Spanish", band == "K-5", change != "removed" | is.na(change)) |> count(scenario)
moving_k5 <- moves |> filter(scenario == "a", band == "K-5", kind == "program")
moving_students <- moves |> filter(scenario == "a") |> rowwise() |>
  mutate(n = strand_students(from_key, language, band)) |> pull(n) |> sum()

sp_from <- moving_k5 |> filter(language == "Spanish") |> distinct(from_key)
sp_k <- lottery_k |> filter(language == "Spanish", year %in% LOTTERY_YEARS)
sp_share <- sum(sp_k$applications[sp_k$key %in% sp_from$from_key]) / sum(sp_k$applications)

acc <- read_data("access_summary.csv") |> filter(group == "Spanish (ages 5-17)")
acc_ci <- read_data("access_robustness_ci.csv")
```

PPS proposes to close or consolidate schools in two scenarios released for the board on October 6, 2026. Both scenarios move most of the district's **Spanish dual language immersion** programs into fewer schools, and move or add Mandarin and Vietnamese sites. This site puts numbers on what that means for immersion families, using PPS's own enrollment and lottery reports.

::: {.stat-row}
::: {.stat}
[`r sp_k5$n[sp_k5$scenario == "sq"]` → `r sp_k5$n[sp_k5$scenario == "a"]`]{.num}
[elementary Spanish immersion sites, today → Scenario A or B]{.label}
:::
::: {.stat}
[`r fmt_pct(sp_share)`]{.num}
[of Spanish kindergarten lottery applications went to programs that would move (2022-23 to 2026-27)]{.label}
:::
::: {.stat}
[`r fmt_n(moving_students)`]{.num}
[immersion students today in programs that move in Scenario A]{.label}
:::
::: {.stat}
[`r fmt_pct(acc$within_1mi[acc$scenario == "sq"])` → `r fmt_pct(acc$within_1mi[acc$scenario == "a"])`]{.num}
[of school-age Spanish speakers live within 1 mile of a K-5 Spanish site (estimate; the drop is `r round(100 * acc_ci$lo[acc_ci$measure == "drop_points"])`–`r round(100 * acc_ci$hi[acc_ci$measure == "drop_points"])` points allowing for survey error)]{.label}
:::
:::

::: {.source}
Tiles, left to right: (1) count of K-5 Spanish immersion sites on the status quo and scenario maps; (2) kindergarten lottery applications to Spanish programs that move in Scenario A, as a share of all Spanish kindergarten applications, pooled over the 2022-23 to 2026-27 lotteries; (3) October 2025 enrollment in each moving language program, in the grades that move, summed over Scenario A's moves; (4) school-age (5–17) Spanish speakers (Census survey estimates by tract, spread across each tract's census blocks by where children live), share living within 1 mile, straight line, of a K-5 Spanish site; the range is a 90% interval for the drop from Census sampling error. `r cite("scenarios", "lottery", "by_grade", "acs", "blocks")`
:::

## What's here

- **[Demand & scorecard](scorecard.qmd)**: how many families apply to each immersion program, compared with the schools the programs would move to; then, for every language, the sites, students and pathways in each scenario.
- **[Sources & methods](methods.qmd)**: where every number comes from and what it can't tell you.

Coming next: access and travel distance, five-year enrollment history (Lent and César Chávez in focus), enrollment projections with adjustable assumptions, and the address lookup map.

This is an independent analysis, not a PPS publication. Scenario details are as transcribed from the October 2026 board packet; check the [PPS rightsizing materials](https://meetings.boardbook.org/Public/Agenda/915?meeting=769955) for the official versions.
:::
